name: flowc_3way_qrb5165
_comment: The same three networks the RISC-V flow runs (mlp_control, dronet, yolo), on the QRB5165's three lanes. dronet and mlp_control are ingested from modelblaster's model zoo — one PyTorch definition, one checkpoint, feeding both flows. yolov8n comes in through the graph_json door because the network that exists on this board is the 640x640 ultralytics export behind the QNN converter, not modelblaster's 64x64 yolov8_nano.
